prompt:
Create one candidate for asset D08, a clean product-source flat lay for the Korean Coupang detail-page library of "루즈핏 쿨토시", manufacturer "살랑".

Final output must be exactly 1024x1024. Compose for this square from the start and keep the complete products center-crop-safe.

IMAGE 1 — CANONICAL PRODUCT IDENTITY:
Image 1 is the real user photograph of the exact sale pair and outranks every other reference for product identity, count, silhouette, proportions, construction, fabric, cuff, thumb opening, and label.
Images 2 through 4 are supporting detail references only.

NON-OVERLAP COMPOSITION — ABSOLUTE HARD REQUIREMENT:
Show exactly two arm sleeves from one identical sale pair.
Lay both sleeves fully extended, parallel, side-by-side on the same flat plane.
Maintain a clearly visible empty background gap of 6% to 10% of canvas width between the complete outer silhouettes from top opening to bottom cuff.
The two sleeves must never touch, cross, overlap, cover, stack, interlock, lean against each other, form an X, form a V that meets, or cast shadows onto each other.
Every pixel of each sleeve outline must remain independently visible against the background.
Place the upper elastic openings on the same horizontal level and the bottom cuff hems on the same horizontal level.
Use a near-vertical orientation with at most 3 degrees of mirrored outward rotation. Keep the products separate all the way from top to bottom.
Leave at least 7% safe margin around the complete pair.

MATCHED SALE-PAIR IDENTITY — ABSOLUTE HARD REQUIREMENT:
Both sleeves must visibly be the same SKU and same finished size.
They must match in fully extended length, flat width, long narrow 47 cm by 14 cm proportions (about 3.36:1), near-parallel side edges, upper elastic opening width and gather density, loose body width, gathered transition, wide hand-cuff length and width, bottom hem construction, side thumb-opening construction, white color, lightweight slightly lustrous fabric, extremely fine horizontal micro-lines, and irregular soft longitudinal drape wrinkles.
The two sleeves should read like naturally manufactured left-and-right mates, not duplicated digital clones, while their finished dimensions and construction remain the same.

LABEL AND FRONT FACE:
Show the labeled outer hand-cuff face on both sleeves.
Each sleeve has one and only one flat sewn white woven label with identical black two-line text: "HELLO" on the first line and "CUTE SLEEVE" on the second line.
Keep label dimensions, type weight, stitch style, and relative placement on the cuff the same on both sleeves.
Show the true side thumb opening on each long cuff in mirrored left-right positions. Do not add holes elsewhere.

REAL-PRODUCT STRUCTURE:
Preserve the narrow gathered elastic upper-arm opening, loose long main body, gathered transition into a long wide hand cuff, true side thumb opening, fine horizontal micro-lines, and soft lengthwise drape shown in the real references.
The main body must remain loose and lightly wrinkled, not tight, tubular, padded, or inflated.
Do not shorten, squash, widen, taper into an hourglass, inflate into a balloon, or turn either sleeve into a leg warmer.
Do not invent thick rib knit, rope-like pleats, compression panels, mesh panels, zippers, drawstrings, silicone strips, anti-slip dots, extra seams, extra openings, extra labels, or detached hang tags.

ART DIRECTION:
Top-down orthographic catalog camera with minimal perspective distortion.
Warm ivory seamless studio background, subtle natural contact shadows directly beneath each sleeve, soft large-source light, neutral white balance, premium but truthful commercial product photography.
No props, hands, people, packaging, rulers, arrows, dimensions, advertising copy, title, caption, badge, icon, price, watermark, UI, or invented logo.
The only visible text is the physical label on each product.

QUALITY_GATE:CLEAN_COMMERCIAL
Controlled studio lighting, smooth continuous gradients, crisp natural edges, clean shadow transitions, physically plausible fabric texture, and low-ISO clarity.
No film grain, sensor noise, chromatic noise, dithering, speckle, crunchy micro-texture, halftone, JPEG artifacts, oversharpening, dirty shadow noise, artificial glitter, waxy blur, plastic smoothing, duplicated-edge artifacts, or merged silhouettes.

FINAL CHECK BEFORE OUTPUT:
Exactly two sleeves.
Same SKU and same finished dimensions.
Fully extended.
Parallel and separated.
Continuous background gap visible between them from top to bottom.
No contact, no overlap, no crossing, no X, no touching shadows.
Both complete silhouettes and all four ends fully visible.
Both labels identical.
Both thumb openings mirrored and structurally identical.
Output exactly 1024x1024.
